for args in [['rev-parse','HEAD'],['config','--show-origin','--get','core.hooksPath'],['config','--show-origin','--get','core.fsmonitor']]:
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',repo,*args],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
